correctness.rationale: For full-dimensional compact convex K in R^d, d≥2, origin achieving maximum ordinary halfspace depth δ(K), and 0<r≤1 with −rK⊂K, every (d+1)-dimensional closed halfspace through middle point (1,0) cuts ≥δ(K)|K| on middle slice. Excluded volume B⊂rK from the lower slice is reflected by x↦−x into K and satisfies the upper slice halfspace; thus outer slices contribute at least r^d|K|. Horizontal halfspaces also satisfy this. Conversely sufficiently tilted halfspaces through any (1,x) contain the full small bottom but exclude upper, selecting middle K mass ≤δ(K)|K|; through upper points can exclude both lower slices, and bottom points have horizontal halfspace mass r^d|K|. Thus max depth exactly (δ+r^d)/(2+r^d), at (1,0). Sharp simplex δ=(d/(d+1))^d from centroid cap and facet caps; barycentric coordinates of reflected vertices show −rΔ⊂Δ iff r≤1/d. ε=r^d/(2+r^d) gives exact m_d/2+(1−m_d/2)ε and d=2 value 2/9+7ε/9, ε≤1/9. Independent exact rational checks at admissible radii support representative halfspaces; no finite sample replaces the all-body reflection argument.
